title: Nightly snapshot records one row per then-open job per calendar date
permissions_required: Backend/database (or dev-support) access to inspect the stored WIP snapshot rows — this is a backend capture behavior that runs without a signed-in user.
preconditions: 1. Open work orders exist across the organization on the capture date.
2. You can inspect the stored snapshot rows after the nightly capture runs (arrange the verification route with the developers).
steps: 1. Note the set of open work orders before the nightly capture runs.
2. After the capture, inspect the stored snapshot rows for that calendar date.
3. Let the capture run again the next day and inspect again.
4. If a manual re-run of the capture is available, re-run it for the same date and inspect that date's rows again.
expected: 1. Once per day the system records one row per then-open work order — one row per work order per calendar date.
2. The next day's capture adds a new row per open work order under the new date; a work order open on both days has one row for each date, never two rows for the same date.
3. Re-running the capture for the SAME date replaces that date's rows — the day's existing rows are removed and re-recorded from current data, never duplicated.
design_ref: none — design not yet available (spec-only authoring)
spec_ref: SV-8667 (specs/wip-work-in-progress.md Story 11 S11-R1; tech-plan-2026-07-29 B1.2 (idempotent re-run — WIP spec Story 11 is silent on re-runs))
notes: The spec defines job behavior only — NO endpoint or table name is specified and none is invented here. VIU-confirm with dev how to trigger/inspect the capture (schedule time, storage, any manual re-run). TECH-PLAN EDIT 2026-07-30: re-run idempotency (delete-and-re-record per location/work order/date) comes from the engineering plan B1.2 — the WIP spec is silent on it (the IV spec's S11-R3 twin has it); confirm live and flag to Chris if the spec re-diff still lacks it.

title: Captured Earned and Remaining use the same maths as the on-screen report
permissions_required: Backend/database (or dev-support) access to inspect the stored WIP snapshot rows, plus the Work In Progress reports permission for the on-screen comparison.
preconditions: 1. An open ZZAUTOTEST work order with known approved labor (partly clocked) and approved parts (partly received) exists and is left UNCHANGED across the capture.
2. You can read the on-screen report on the capture date and the stored snapshot row afterward.
steps: 1. On the capture date, note the work order's Earned and Remaining on the Work In Progress report.
2. After the nightly capture, read the same work order's captured Earned and Remaining in the snapshot row.
3. Compare the pairs.
expected: 1. The captured Earned equals the on-screen Earned and the captured Remaining equals the on-screen Remaining, to the cent — the snapshot uses the identical computation for both figures, so the two can never diverge for a given work order on the capture date.
